parts.html: The K-43 kitchen is a modern straight kitchen built on a contrast of color and texture. The lower cabinets and tall side units are a deep dark burgundy, close to wine red. The central upper row is dark graphite with a pronounced vertical fluted texture. The kitchen comes out austere and memorable.
Smooth burgundy fronts below and a fluted graphite row above: the dark kitchen doesn’t look flat, and the relief runs as an accent line across the full width of the work area.
The work area is dark too: the countertop looks black or nearly black, and the backsplash is in the same range. Together they form one solid dark block, with the fluted graphite row running above it.

In the visualization, on the left is a tall dark burgundy unit with a built-in oven, and on the right another tall closed unit in the same wine shade. Between them runs the main work line: base cabinets with the graphite row above.
Straight layout
All the cabinets stand along one wall. A kitchen like this is easier to fit into an apartment with an open floor plan: the rest of the room stays free.
The kitchen takes up 4.1 linear meters of wall; the standard model measures 4.1 × 2.4 × 0.6 m.

One line holds the cabinets, the work surface, built-in appliances, and tall pantry units. During design, we will position the sink, cooktop, appliances, and cabinet interiors to suit your room and its utility connections.
The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances, but the appliances themselves are not included in the price of the furniture set.
The standard configuration has no island — all the cabinets stand against the wall.
Materials
The upper and lower fronts are laminated chipboard. The catalog lists the model’s color as red; in the interior, this reads as dark burgundy lower fronts and a graphite upper row.
The K-43 carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.
Hardware and handles
The K-43 hinged doors close smoothly: the standard configuration uses Hettich hinges with soft-close.
Drawers run on Quadro Hettich concealed undermount slides: the runners sit under the drawer bottom, can’t be seen from the side, and everything inside looks neat.
A cargo pull-out is not part of the standard configuration.
There are no lift-up mechanisms.
Handles are included. In the visualization, dark horizontal profiles separate the rows of cabinets, so the fronts look completely plain.

Lower front type: Laminated chipboard, dark burgundy / wine decor
Carcass type: 18 mm laminated chipboard

Hinge type: Hettich with soft-close mechanism

Additional features shown in the visualization: Tall unit with a built-in oven on the left, tall closed unit on the right, dark backsplash, black work area, and graphite ribbed upper row.
We will make the K-43 to your dimensions. The front color, countertop, hardware, and materials can be changed — for more affordable or more expensive options.
